implemented_bounded_subroute.window: source-bound quarter-turn endpoints on one tan-half monotonic branch without a pole
implemented_bounded_subroute.reduction: x = tan(theta/2), yielding P(x)/(1+x^2)^n with exact rational P and strictly positive real denominator
implemented_bounded_subroute.decision_engine: MC-032 exact rational polynomial Sturm/root/multiplicity machinery
established_claims: exact root count on the bounded rational tan-half window
exact detection of whether any open-window root is repeated
exact multiplicity and sign-change classification at an exact rational tan-half event witness
binary floating point, epsilon and tolerance are absent from the correctness path
not_claimed: no decision route for arbitrary rational-turn endpoints
no decision route for polynomial-modulated trigonometric predicates
no decision route for general coupled exponential-polynomial predicates
no source-wide proof that every required event reduces to this sublanguage

boundary_controls: sin(theta) simple crossing at exact tan-half witness 0
1-cos(theta) even-multiplicity tangency at exact tan-half witness 0
sin(theta)^3 odd-multiplicity singular crossing using the exact 3*sin(theta)-sin(3*theta) identity
cos(2*theta) has two hidden open-window roots counted exactly by Sturm evidence
tan-half pole crossings fail closed instead of being sampled across
polynomial-modulated/general coupled analytic predicates retain PB-007-01
binary-float coefficient or endpoint authority is rejected
resource refusal is explicitly not a truth value

full_blocker_review.reason: The implemented exact subroute is strictly smaller than the required MC-003/MC-007 analytic predicate grammar. Required phase-sensitive/helical histories can generate polynomial-modulated trigonometric/exponential-polynomial event predicates and arbitrary rational-turn source windows. No unconditional finite exact source-wide decision construction for tangential, multiple-root or singular events in that full grammar has been established.
